prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-49799 from Upwell Cloud
prose.body: Hi there! Hope you are having a great week. Just a quick nudge regarding invoice INV-49799 for 8676.40 USDC. We wanted to ensure you have the payment details handy. As per our standard process, please send the funds to our usual wallet address: 0xf56ff55328f9e3808116d2bf3d88e91a1bbb7e40. This is the same address you have used previously for Upwell Cloud services. If you have already sent this payment, please disregard this note. We appreciate your business with Greywater Robotics. If you need a copy of the invoice or have any questions, just reply to this email and our team will be happy to help. Thanks for your prompt attention to this matter. Best regards, Upwell Cloud Billing Team
